premise: The same fixed-home position was assumed to be clamped consistently on construction and reload, and saved rack coordinates were assumed to control restoration.
method: Single 390x844 DPR2 isolated-context experiment: fresh unlock, ordinary reload, explicit resize event, then saved-x sentinel reload. HTTP response observers only; product source files unchanged.

loads.name: fresh
loads.renderer: ANGLE (Microsoft Corporation, D3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti), OpenGL ES 3.1)

loads.name: reload
loads.renderer: ANGLE (Microsoft Corporation, D3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti), OpenGL ES 3.1)

loads.name: saved-x-sentinel
loads.renderer: ANGLE (Microsoft Corporation, D3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti), OpenGL ES 3.1)

findings.cause: build() overwrites saved coordinates with the raw fixed home and places without clampUnits; layoutAll clamps that same home later. This affects fresh creation as well as restore.
findings.timingCaveat: Both fresh and reload eventually reached the clamped position in this experiment. The previous 17px comparison depends on when a resize/adaptive-resolution callback has occurred, not a permanent saved-position divergence.
findings.proposedFix: Use one home-to-clamped-position path before first place and on all later layouts. Keep saving rack ownership/state/order, but do not treat stored coordinates as the position of immovable furniture.
